title: Extraction of DNA from Frozen Islet Repository Samples
author: IIDP-HIPP
materials: Assemble all items described in Materials .
Use NanoDrop to measure DNA concentration.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 500 µL Nuclei Lysis Solution with 120 µL 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) and chill the mixture on ice.

steps.title: Lyse Islet Pellet with Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL chilled Nuclei Lysis Buffer and 20 µL proteinase K to the islet pellet, vortex vigorously for 10 seconds, then incubate at 65 °C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL chilled Nuclei Lysis Buffer and 20 µL proteinase K to the islet pellet.

steps.title: Add RNase and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution to the lysate, invert the tube 2–5 times, incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes, then cool to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution to the lysate.

steps.title: Add Protein Precipitation Solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution, vortex, and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with Isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL tube containing 600 µL room‑temperature isopropanol, mix gently by inversion, and incubate at –20 °C for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL tube containing 600 µL room‑temperature isopropanol.

steps.title: Second Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000–16,000 ×g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash of DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, add 600 µL room‑temperature 70 % ethanol, and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Second Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 13,000–16,000 ×g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Air‑Dry DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Aspirate the ethanol and air‑dry the pellet for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA Rehydration Solution to the pellet, incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA Rehydration Solution to the pellet.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
